headline: Luigi 'Guilty AF' Mangione 🍑💥 Pleads to CEO Pop 💉🩸
text: Luigi Mangione 🍝🕵️‍♂️ walked into NYC 🗽⚖️ federal court looking like beige prison chic 👕⛓️ ready to DROP THE MIC 🎤 on the CEO hit 🎯🔫 that broke the internet 💥🌍!
